job.title: Lead Software Engineer
job.pay_full: $140,000 – $231,000 a year (O'Fallon, Missouri), with a possible annual bonus or commissions

details.about: Mastercard's Global Credit Authorization team needs a Lead Software Engineer to design, build and validate the mission-critical, highly available systems that process secure card transactions worldwide. The role combines hands-on engineering with deep quality engineering: functional behaviour, transaction integrity, resiliency, performance, failover, recovery, monitoring and production readiness.
duties: Build software, test applications, utilities and automation in Java and/or Python
Define and run validation strategies covering transaction integrity, performance, resiliency, failover, recovery and production readiness
Build and maintain lab and lower-level test environments that mirror production networks and traffic
Validate behaviour across TCP/IP, persistent connections, proxies, load balancers and routing
Run end-to-end functional, integration, regression, failover, load, soak and capacity tests
Create automated testing frameworks and tools
Troubleshoot complex issues using code, logs, traces, metrics and packet captures, and drive root-cause analysis
Produce acceptance criteria, certification documents and production-readiness recommendations
needs: Experience as a Senior or Lead Software Engineer, Software Developer or SDET on complex enterprise systems
Strong hands-on development in Java and/or Python (services, automation, test frameworks)
Building and troubleshooting test and lab environments for distributed applications
Strong TCP/IP networking: persistent connections, routing, proxies, load balancers, DNS
Analysing packet captures, logs, traces and telemetry
Functional, integration, resiliency, performance and end-to-end testing of highly available systems
Failover, recovery, disaster-recovery and business-continuity testing
Load, stress, soak and capacity testing for high-throughput services
Bachelor's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, Engineering, Mathematics or related, or equivalent experience
nice: Financial messaging (ISO 8583), payment switching or telecom transaction platforms
Testing proxy, load-balancer or active-active failover architectures
Production certification for customer-facing transaction platforms
Observability and monitoring practices for enterprise services
details.benefits: Pay range $140,000 – $231,000 a year for O'Fallon, Missouri, with a possible annual bonus or commissions; pay depends on location, skills and experience. Benefits include medical, prescription, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, FSA and HSA, 16 weeks of new-parent leave, 80 hours of paid sick and safe time, 25 vacation days and 5 personal days (pro-rated), 10 paid holidays, a 401(k) with company match, fitness reimbursement and tuition reimbursement.
notes: Hybrid: three days a week on site in O'Fallon, Missouri
Mastercard says it intends to fill the role by January 20, 2027
